key_insight: FlowPipe turns data-preparation pipeline search into conditional probabilistic flow generation, using C-GFlowNets to better assign credit across long operator sequences while guided by LLM-derived semantic priors.
engineering_relevance: It offers a more practical way to automate table cleaning and feature transformation for machine learning workflows, reducing manual pipeline design effort and improving model-ready data quality.
method: C-GFlowNets with Trajectory Balance to link final validation reward back to early pipeline choices
FiLM-based deep semantic modulation to inject LLM-derived dataset context into the policy
Failure-aware flow objective to reduce invalid states and focus exploration on promising pipelines
evidence_signal: On two benchmark suites with 74 real-world datasets, FlowPipe improved accuracy by 11.96% on average and reached 12.5x faster training convergence versus SOTA baselines.
watch_item: The approach depends on reliable dataset semantics from LLM priors and adds model complexity, so performance may be sensitive to prompt quality, feature encoding, and training stability in new domains.
paper_title: FlowPipe: LLM-Enhanced Conditional Generative Flow Networks for Data Preparation Pipeline Construction
